annotations.title: psamtik
annotations.description: Psamtik is mentioned with the titles of 'chief physician' and of 'overseer of the Temehu'. The deceased is also referred to as 'the Osiris'.

annotations.title: tagemiraset
annotations.description: From the coffin as well as from the stela, we know that the name of Psamtik's mother was Tꜣ-gm-jr-Ꜣst, but only his stela mentions the name of his father, Ḥr-sꜣ-Ꜣst.

annotations.title: nut
annotations.description: Below the collar is Nut, holding in each hand, and spreading her wings over the deceased to ward off evil influences.

annotations.title: shining
annotations.description: On the right and left sides are eight speeches of gods, followed their by depictions. Four of these are the sons of Horus, namely Imset, Duamutef, Hapi, and Qebehsenuef, depicted top-most. Three more are Maitef, Horkhentyirty, and Kherybaqef, who together with the sons of Horus are the Seven Shining Ones, the protectors of the body of Osiris. The eighth god is Anubis, the god associated with mummification, whose speech is left implicit.

annotations.title: isisnephthys
annotations.description: At the bottom are speeches by Isis and Nephthys.

annotations.title: Front
annotations.description: Column 1 Cf. PT 637b-c: rḏj.n n=k Ḥr msw=f jw sꜣ=sn ẖr=k n ḥm jm=sn fꜣ=sn ṯw. Column 2 Cf. PT 638a-b: pšš.n sj mwt=k Nwt ḥr=k m rn=s n Štpt rḏj.n=s wn=k m nṯr n ḫftj=k m rn=k n nṯr. Column 3 Cf. PT 638c: ẖnm=s ṯw m-ꜥ jḫt nb ḏwt m rn=s n ẖnmt wrt. Column 4 Cf. PT 638d: ṯwt wr jm msw=s, PT 639: ḥtp n=k Gbb mr.n=f ṯw ḫw.n=f ṯw rḏj.n=f n=k tp=k rḏj.n=f jꜥb ṯw Ḏḥwtj tm jrt=k. The conventional translation of tm jrt=k is 'so that what is against you might end' (Allen 2005). The writing here with may suggest a reinterpretation. Column 5

fragments.transliteration: ḏd-mdw hꜣ Wsjr wr-swnw jmj-rꜣ ṯmḥw Psmṯk
fragments.translation: Words to be said: O Osiris, chief physician, overseer of the Temehu, Psamtik.

fragments.transliteration: Ḥr msw=f sꜣ=sn ḫr=k
fragments.translation: Horus (has given to you) his children, that they might stay with you,

fragments.transliteration: n ḥm jm=sn fꜣ=sn ṯw
fragments.translation: and none of them back away, when they carry you.

fragments.transliteration: pšš sj mwt=k Nwt ḥr=k m rn=s n Štpt
fragments.translation: Your mother Nut has spread herself over you, in her name of She of Wadi Natrun.

fragments.transliteration: rḏj{t}.n=s wn=k m nṯr n ḫftj=k m rn=k n nṯr
fragments.translation: She has made you a god without enemies, in your name of God.

fragments.transliteration: ẖnm.n=s ṯw m-ꜥ jḫt nb ḏw m rn=s n ẖnmt wrt
fragments.translation: She has guarded you from all evil, in her name of Great Guardian.

fragments.transliteration: Wsjr wr-swnw jmj-rꜣ ṯmḥw Psmṯk ms.n Tꜣ-gm-jr-Ꜣst
fragments.translation: The Osiris, chief physician, overseer of the Temehu, Psamtik, born of Tagemiraset.

fragments.transliteration: ṯwt wr msw=s
fragments.translation: You are the greatest of her children.

fragments.transliteration: ḥtp n=k Gbb mr.n=f ṯw ḫw.n=f ṯw
fragments.translation: Geb has been gracious to you, as he has loved you and protected you.

fragments.transliteration: rḏj{t}.n=f n=k tp=k rḏj{t}.n=f jꜥb ṯw Ḏḥwtj tm jrj=k
fragments.translation: He has given you your head and had Thoth assemble you, so that what belongs to you is complete.

fragments.transliteration: ꜣḫw rḏj{t}.n Jnpw m sꜣ qrst nt Wsjr
fragments.translation: O akh spirits: Anubis has granted as protection the burial of the Osiris,

fragments.transliteration: m sꜣ qrst nt Wsjr wr-swnw Psmṯk
fragments.translation: as protection the burial of the Osiris, chief physician, Psamtik.

annotations.title: Right side
annotations.description: Column 1 Cf. BD 151: jw=j m sꜣ Wsjr, 'I am the protection of the Orisis ...'. Column 2 Column 3 Column 4

fragments.transliteration: ḏd-mdw jn Mꜣꜣ-jt=f wnn(=j) m sꜣ=k
fragments.translation: Words to be said by Maitef: I will be your protection.

fragments.transliteration: ḏd-mdw jn Ḥr-ḫnty-jrtj wnn(=j) m sꜣ=k
fragments.translation: Words to be said by Horkhentyirty: I will be your protection.

fragments.transliteration: ḏd-mdw jn Ḥꜥpj wnn(=j) m sꜣ=k

fragments.transliteration: ḏd-mdw jn Qbḥ-snw=f wnn(=j) m sꜣ=k
fragments.translation: Words to be said by Qebehsenuef: I will be your protection.

fragments.transliteration: ḏd-mdw jn H̱rj-bꜣq=f wnn(=j) m sꜣ=k
fragments.translation: Words to be said by Kherybaqef: I will be your protection.

fragments.transliteration: ḏd-mdw jn Jnpw nṯr ꜥꜣ nb qrst
fragments.translation: Words to be said by Anubis, great god, lord of burial.

fragments.transliteration: ḏd-mdw jn Ꜣst
fragments.translation: Words to be said by Isis:

fragments.transliteration: Wsjr wr-swnw Psmṯk
fragments.translation: The Osiris, chief physician, Psamtik,

fragments.transliteration: jnk snt=k Ꜣst{t} wnn m sꜣ=k
fragments.translation: I, your sister Isis, will be your protection.

annotations.title: Bottom left
annotations.description: Cf. BD 151: ḏd-mdw jn Nbt-ḥwt pẖr.n=j ḥꜣ sn=j Wsjr.

fragments.transliteration: ḏd-mdw jn Nbt-ḥwt
fragments.translation: Words to be said by Nephthys:

fragments.transliteration: pẖr(=j) ḥꜣ sn(=j) Wsjr wr-swnw
fragments.translation: I will go around my brother, the Osiris, chief physician,

fragments.transliteration: Psmṯk n gꜣḥ ḥꜥw=k
fragments.translation: Psamtik, you body will not be tired.

annotations.description: Line 1 Line 2 Cf. PT 630: sꜣ.n n=k Ꜣst ḥnꜥ Nbt-ḥwt m Sꜣwtj n nb=sn jm=k m rn=k n nb Sꜣwtj n nṯr=sn jm=k m rn=k n nṯr.

fragments.translation: Words to be said: The Osiris, chief physician, overseer of the Temehu, Psamtik, they came to you.
